description: The Budget Setup window (every setup table's full editor, in a window of its own) may call only the commands its tabs use: get_view; host_info (which host it runs in); the fringe, group, global, unit, set, location and currency tables (editing, adding, deleting, renaming everywhere, their order, short codes and in-use counts, a global's details and the numbers-on-screen settings); charges, credits, info, settings with renumbering accounts to a new pattern, and the baseline; and the personal setup library beside each table (its view, copying items to and from it, its folders, and picking its file in Rust's own dialogs: no path comes from the page) with its Setup packs section (listing packs, exporting and importing them through Rust's own dialogs, showing the Packs folder); and send and receive events between the windows. Nothing on the selected lines, no notes, find, history, file, save, undo, tab or window commands: it passes those keys to the main window.
